title: Project: Nuclei
description: Adds uranium ore, lead ore and an enrichment process for making uranium rods. Also adds graphite rods (crafted with coal), a nuke, a radioactive seperator and various crafting components. In general this is a (kinda) scientific industrial progression mod.
body: Adds nuclear aspects all for a nuke. Uranium rods are made from crushed uranium (obtainable from uranium ore) and then goes trough 2 steps to become an enriched uranium rod. Graphite rods are also needed for the nuclear bomb. They are otained from coal (carbon). The nuke is crafted from a casing, made from concrete and then graphite rods, gunpowder and enriched uranium rods are used to make the fission elements themselves. Adds a geiger counter, and circuit components for crafting the advanced processor, which is used to craft the radiochemical seperator (seperates radioactive elements and produces waste) and contaminated water, that gives poison II on contact. Overall this mod is an industrial progression mod, which you could add to a modpack.
